title: Knead Saudia Wild Mushroom Stir-fry
description: A tangy and juicy high-protein-friendly meal-prep dish featuring wild mushrooms that is perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Place the saudia mushrooms in a bowl, sprinkle with lemon juice, turmeric powder, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes (if using). Toss well to coat evenly. Let it sit for about 5 minutes.
Heat olive oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Add sliced onion and sauté until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant but not browned.
Gently fold the mushroom mixture into the pan along with the lemon juice marinade, ensuring mushrooms are evenly coated. Allow to sit and absorb the flavors for an additional 2 minutes.
Reduce heat to medium-low, add salt and pepper as per taste preferences. Stir-fry for about 5-7 more minutes until the mushrooms are slightly crisp and the sauce thickens slightly.
Serve hot with a side of quinoa or any preferred grain-based dish for added nutritional value.
